comparison.objective: Replace a drive belt by sliding the motor inward for slack and then tensioning the new belt; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Motor repositioning, compliant belt routing, and tension adjustment versus rigid mandrel alignment, impact fracture, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: New belt installed and tensioned after motor adjustment versus four contact-loaded tang fractures with containment and no damage. Numeric belt thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Belt routing and tensioning are not equivalent to controlled notch fracture, despite shared force regulation.
